scenario.title: Small-business generator and maintenance package with incomplete service term
scenario.summary: The real requirement combines a 200 kW generator/ATS with preventive maintenance and is a small-business set-aside. Controlled clarification supplies the missing maintenance term and commercial ceiling; a cheaper synthetic supplier is ineligible.

realism.notes: The 200 kW generator/ATS requirement, preventive-maintenance scope, and small-business set-aside are frozen public facts. Maintenance term, budget, delivery, supplier profiles, and quote values are synthetic.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.306 Exchanges with offerors after receipt of proposals
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for clarification/discussion events; used only to calibrate synthetic interaction structure.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.206 Amending the solicitation
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for controlled buyer changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for quotation evaluation across compliance, price, and delivery.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting requirements or synthetic scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Lower-price supplier that is not eligible under the controlled set-aside representation.

events.observation: Synthetic buyer clarification: preventive maintenance term is 12 months; maximum package price USD 225,000; delivery within 150 days.
Supplier A quotes USD 210,000 for the 200 kW generator, ATS, and 12 months of preventive maintenance with 120-day delivery.
Supplier B quotes USD 190,000 for the complete package with 100-day delivery but is not eligible for the controlled set-aside.
Supplier C quotes USD 205,000 for the complete package with 130-day delivery.

hard_constraints.description: The missing maintenance term and commercial terms must be clarified before RFQ.
Award must include one 200 kW generator and automatic transfer capability.
Award must include 12 months of preventive maintenance.
Awarded price must not exceed USD 225,000.
Awarded supplier must be eligible under the small-business set-aside.
Both required initial-state line items must be covered exactly once.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C is the lowest-price eligible complete package.
Supplier A is eligible and feasible but more expensive than Supplier C.

failure_conditions: Awarding the ineligible lower-price Supplier B.
Awarding a quote that omits the ATS or preventive-maintenance scope.

economic_objective.description: Among acceptable feasible terminal outcomes, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
